bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
WT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.worktrees/search-colors-5a93de6"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = 5a93de671ee158205759bb6e264cd3cd48466743
LOG="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
if docker build --progress=plain -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6 "$WT" >"$LOG" 2>&1; then exit 0; fi
python3 - "$LOG" <<'PY'
import pathlib,re,sys
s=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(errors='replace')
tests=[
(81,r'no space left|disk quota exceeded'),
(82,r'network.*(unreachable|timeout)|connection.*(refused|reset)|i/o timeout'),
(83,r'no such host|lookup .* failed|temporary failure in name resolution'),
(84,r'ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE|frozen-lockfile'),
(85,r'failed to resolve source metadata|manifest unknown|pull access denied'),
(86,r'failed to calculate checksum|not found: not found'),
(87,r'out of memory|killed|exit code: 137'),
(88,r'permission denied'),
(89,r'ERR_PNPM_|pnpm install'),
(90,r'Could not resolve|✘ \[ERROR\]|esbuild'),
(91,r'Cannot connect to the Docker daemon'),
(92,r'TS[0-9]{4}'),
(93,r'process .* did not complete successfully|exit code: [1-9]'),
]
for code,pattern in tests:
 if re.search(pattern,s,re.I):sys.exit(code)
sys.exit(94)
PY
